FAQ

Questions people
ask before joining.

No sales-y answers. Direct, honest responses to the real questions engineers and career-switchers ask before making this decision.

📋
Download Full Syllabus

See every module, tool, and concept covered in the Multi-Cloud DevSecOps with AI programme — before you commit to anything.

📄 Complete Course Outline 🔒 No Email Required 📱 Instant Download
01I have no IT background. Can I still learn DevOps and get placed?▼

Absolutely. Students from BPO, banking, teaching, mechanical engineering, and finance have all successfully transitioned into DevOps and Cloud roles through this programme. The curriculum starts from absolute basics — Linux, networking, scripting — and builds progressively. One student went from being an Amazon investigator (Chinese language specialist) to a DevOps Engineer at Capgemini at ₹16 LPA. Background matters far less than consistency and commitment.

02How long does the programme take? I have a full-time job.▼

The programme is specifically designed for working professionals. Weekend and evening batches run concurrently so you do not have to quit your job. The full curriculum typically spans 4–6 months depending on the track and your pace. Many students complete Kubernetes certification while holding full-time IT roles — the schedule is built around your reality, not the other way around.

03What are the certification pass rates? What if I fail the exam?▼

CKA batch pass rate: 95%. CKAD: 100%. Terraform Associate: 100%. CKS: 82% — the hardest Kubernetes exam that exists. If you take training seriously and complete all mock exams, the odds are heavily in your favour. Most exam vouchers include one free retake. Additional doubt-clearing is available if needed before a reattempt.

04How is this different from YouTube tutorials or Udemy courses?▼

YouTube and Udemy give you information. This programme gives you outcomes. The difference: live doubt-clearing, real cluster labs where things break and you fix them, troubleshooting sessions that build actual debugging instincts, mock interviews that prepare you for real hiring panels, and a personally reviewed resume that gets you shortlisted. 95% of interview questions come from what is covered in class — because it is taught by someone actively working in the industry.

05Do I need expensive hardware or paid cloud subscriptions?▼

No. A standard laptop with 8GB RAM (16GB preferred) is sufficient. Cloud lab work uses free-tier accounts on AWS, Azure, and GCP — you will be guided on setup. For Kubernetes practice, lightweight local setups (kind, minikube) are used alongside cluster access provided during the programme. There is no significant out-of-pocket cost beyond the training fee and exam vouchers.

06Will I get placement assistance after completing the programme?▼

There is no formal placement guarantee — any trainer who makes that promise is not being honest. What you get is comprehensive placement support: personally reviewed resume, mock technical and behavioural interviews, career guidance on which roles to target, and salary negotiation advice. The combination of certification + real portfolio + strong resume + interview readiness is what has led students to offers at IBM, Mphasis, Capgemini, Accenture, and UST Global.

07I have a career gap of 1–5 years. Will companies still hire me?▼

Yes. A CKA, CKAD, or AWS certification completely resets your resume narrative. Hiring managers looking for cloud engineers care far more about demonstrated skills than employment history gaps. Multiple students with 1–5 year gaps have been placed in MNCs. The interview coaching also specifically addresses how to present and frame career breaks confidently and professionally.

08What is the fee? Is there an EMI or instalment option?▼

Programme fees vary by track (Kubernetes-only, full DevSecOps, AWS bootcamp, etc.) and batch format. Contact directly via email or LinkedIn for current pricing and batch schedules — fees are kept competitive and updated based on batch size. EMI and instalment options are available. Given that students have landed packages of ₹16–30 LPA, the return on investment is typically recovered within the first 2 months of placement.

09What is the batch size? Will I get personal attention?▼

Batch sizes are intentionally kept small — typically 15 to 25 students — to ensure every participant gets direct interaction during live sessions. This is not a 500-student online cohort where you are invisible. Dedicated doubt-clearing sessions, 1-on-1 slots for complex topics, and a group support channel are all part of the programme structure.

10Which companies and roles can I realistically target after this?▼

Realistically: DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, SRE, DevSecOps, CloudOps, Cloud Admin — across service-based companies (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini) and product-based companies (startups to enterprise). Students have been placed at IBM, Mphasis (₹26.7 LPA), UST Global, Accenture, Airtel Payments Bank, and Wood Mackenzie. The international market is also accessible — one student is now a Senior DevOps Engineer internationally at ₹30 LPA+.

11 Are session recordings available if I miss a class? 📹 Important ▼

Yes — recordings of every live session are available to all enrolled students.

Life happens — work deadlines, travel, health — and missing an occasional session should not derail your progress. All class recordings are uploaded and accessible within 24 hours of each live session. You can replay them as many times as needed, pause at any point, revisit difficult topics, and come prepared to the next live session with specific questions. Recordings remain accessible throughout your full programme duration.

12 What is the refund policy? ⚠ Policy ▼
⚠️
Strict No-Refund Policy
Once access to sessions, recordings, materials, and resources has been granted, no refunds will be issued under any circumstances — including change of mind, schedule conflict, or inability to attend.

This policy exists because value is delivered immediately upon enrolment — live sessions, personalised feedback, recordings, and career support cannot be "returned." Before enrolling, please ensure:

  • ✦You have spoken directly with Raham about the programme
  • ✦You understand the schedule and commitment required
  • ✦You have reviewed the full syllabus (download available above)
  • ✦You are genuinely committed to completing the programme

We encourage every prospective student to ask every question they have before paying — that is exactly what the free consultation is for.
